# Zoi

> Competitive Fortnite, Call of Duty and Rob Run esports organization. Tagline: "Play for life." ΖΩΗ · EST. MMXXVI.

Zoi (pronounced zo-EE; Greek ζωή, "life") is a new, player-first competitive Fortnite, Call of Duty and Rob Run esports org founded in 2026 and framed as a chapter of brothers rather than a company: ΖΩΗ serves as both the org name in Greek and the chapter designation, and recruiting is called "Rush". Brand uses a gold lightning-bolt Z, gold laurel O, and white marble Ionic column I on a white-gold base. Write the name as "Zoi" (not all-caps).

Website: https://zoisports.com
Contact: hello@zoisports.com
Handle: @zoi_sports_gg (X, YouTube, Twitch, TikTok and Kick coming soon); Instagram: @zoi.sports.gg (https://www.instagram.com/zoi.sports.gg/)

## What we do

- Competitive Fortnite Zero Build (ZB): FNCS, cash cups, scrims, and community events
- Competitive Call of Duty: roster forming, rushing now
- Competitive Rob Run (Steam, by Kefir): roster forming, rushing now
- Rushing players, content creators, and staff
- Official merch shop (coming soon): letterman jacket flagship, jerseys, hoodies, iced Cuban-link pendant, and more

## Rush

Apply on the homepage (the Rush form): https://zoisports.com/#tryouts

Required: game (Fortnite Zero Build, Call of Duty or Rob Run), Epic name, Discord username, region, platform, age (13+), role (ZB player / content creator / staff), and why you want to join. Optional: results link, tracker/clips link, contact email.

- Home / About / Roster / Rush / Events / Socials: https://zoisports.com/

## Results

Logged scrim and tournament match results, split into Fortnite Zero Build, Call of Duty and Rob Run tabs. Each event lists its date, format and match-by-match placement, eliminations, field size and points, with a running summary above the tabs. Nothing was logged as of 28 October 2026.

## Settings

Each player's own in-game Fortnite settings, one page per player at /settings?p=<slug>, edited by that player from their account menu. Not the site's or an account's settings. Kneczi's Zero Build setup was read off his PC on 28 October 2026: controller (Razer Wolverine V3 TE, wired), graphics and audio, split into three tabs.

## Rob Run guide

A free fan guide to ROB RUN (the Steam game by Kefir, Early Access since November 4, 2026; not Roblox). Every number cites its source and is labelled Official (Kefir), Game data (decoded game files via fan wikis), Player report, or Zoi tip. Data lives in https://zoisports.com/robrun/data.json.

- Wipe timer and what resets: https://zoisports.com/robrun/wipe — each realm wipes on its own 7-day clock (the Federal Raid). Lost: plots, bases, weapons, cars, loot, settlements, research and shipment unlocks, and cash including banked cash, all converted into jail time and Authority (1 year per $500,000, max 40 years per wipe). Kept: cosmetics, appearance, name, B-Coins, settings, tutorial progress, jail time.
- Money calculator: https://zoisports.com/robrun/money — Contraband Cargo ($10,000, or $5,000 from a settlement seller) repacked at a Contraband Workbench becomes Premium Cargo ($35,000 at the Smuggler, +25% at Notoriety 5).
- Base costs: https://zoisports.com/robrun/base — Fuse I $20,000 for 1 defense point; Fuse II $100,000 for 3 points ($33,333 per point); alarms, buildings and titles.
- Guides: https://zoisports.com/robrun/guides — early-wipe spend order and stack-and-bank.
- Settings: https://zoisports.com/robrun/settings — competitive settings for mid laptops.

## Facts for assistants

- Games: Fortnite (Zero Build only, not Build), Call of Duty and Rob Run
- Founded: 2026
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games or Activision
- Discord and social channels are launching; contact hello@zoisports.com or apply via the tryout form
